caption_used: Accuracy comparison of six reinforcement learning configurations across three benchmarks: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. Each benchmark displays grouped bars for DAPO+Self-reflection (solid blue), DAPO (hatched blue), SRPO (solid orange), GRPO (hatched orange), PPO+Self-reflection (solid green), and PPO (hatched green). In Mathverse, SRPO achieves the highest accuracy at approximately 56%, while DAPO+Self-reflection follows at roughly 55%, with the remaining methods clustered between 53% and 54%. Across MMLU, GRPO leads with approximately 57%, narrowly exceeding DAPO+Self-reflection, and PPO trails at about 54.5%. In the Physics benchmark, DAPO+Self-reflection reaches roughly 61%, with SRPO close behind at 60.5% and PPO at the lowest with approximately 57%. Notably, the self-reflection variants do not consistently outperform their base counterparts, as GRPO surpasses PPO+Self-reflection in both Mathverse and MMLU.

raw_responses.Bulgarian: DESCRIPTION: Фигурата представлява групирана стълбовидна диаграма, която показва и сравнява точността (Accuracy) в проценти за шест конфигурации на reinforcement learning върху три бенчмарка. Хоризонталната ос съдържа категориите „Mathverse“, „MMLU“ и „Physics“, подредени отляво надясно, като за всяка категория има група от шест стълба. Вертикалната ос е означена „Accuracy (%)“ и е с линейна скала приблизително от 50 до 62, с равномерни деления през 2 единици (50, 52, 54, 56, 58, 60, 62). Данните са представени чрез шест серии, разграничени по цвят и щриховка, с легенда в горната част: DAPO+Self-reflection (плътен син), DAPO (син с диагонална щриховка), SRPO (плътен оранжев), GRPO (оранжев с диагонална щриховка), PPO+Self-reflection (плътен зелен) и PPO (зелен с диагонална щриховка). При Mathverse височините са приблизително: DAPO около 53%, DAPO+Self-reflection около 56%, GRPO около 53–54%, SRPO около 56%, PPO около 53–54% и PPO+Self-reflection около 54–55%. При MMLU стойностите са приблизително: DAPO около 56%, DAPO+Self-reflection около 57%, GRPO около 56%, SRPO около 57%, PPO около 55% и PPO+Self-reflection около 56%. При Physics стойностите са приблизително: DAPO около 57–58%, DAPO+Self-reflection около 61%, GRPO около 58%, SRPO около 60–61%, PPO около 57% и PPO+Self-reflection около 59%. Стълбовете са с еднаква ширина, групирани плътно по бенчмарк, без допълнителни анотации върху самите стълбове, като визуалното разграничаване се постига чрез комбинация от плътни цветове и диагонална щриховка.
raw_responses.Chinese: DESCRIPTION: 该图为分组柱状图，用于展示并对比六种强化学习配置在三个基准任务（Mathverse、MMLU、Physics）上的准确率（Accuracy）。横轴为类别轴，依次标注 Mathverse、MMLU、Physics；纵轴为数值轴，标签为 “Accuracy (%)”，采用线性刻度，范围约从 50 到 62，刻度间隔为 2（50、52、54、56、58、60、62）。每个基准下有 6 根并列柱，按图例对应：DAPO+Self-reflection 为实心蓝色柱，DAPO 为蓝色斜线填充柱，SRPO 为实心橙色柱，GRPO 为橙色斜线填充柱，PPO+Self-reflection 为实心绿色柱，PPO 为绿色斜线填充柱；图例位于图上方。Mathverse 组中各柱高度约为：DAPO 约 53.1%，DAPO+Self-reflection 约 56.1%，GRPO 约 53.4%，SRPO 约 55.8%，PPO 约 53.3%，PPO+Self-reflection 约 54.5%。MMLU 组中约为：DAPO 约 55.9%，DAPO+Self-reflection 约 56.9%，GRPO 约 55.8%，SRPO 约 57.1%，PPO 约 54.6%，PPO+Self-reflection 约 56.2%。Physics 组中约为：DAPO 约 57.5%，DAPO+Self-reflection 约 61.0%，GRPO 约 58.1%，SRPO 约 60.6%，PPO 约 56.9%，PPO+Self-reflection 约 59.1%。柱状图未显示按数值排序的排列方式，也未见单独的高亮标注；背景带有水平网格线以辅助读取数值。
raw_responses.English: DESCRIPTION: The figure is a grouped vertical bar chart illustrating accuracy (%) for six reinforcement learning configurations across three benchmarks. The horizontal axis lists the categorical benchmarks Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics from left to right, and the vertical axis is labeled “Accuracy (%)” on a linear scale spanning roughly 50 to 62 with tick marks every 2 units. Each benchmark group contains six bars corresponding to the legend: DAPO+Self-reflection (solid blue), DAPO (blue with diagonal hatching), SRPO (solid orange), GRPO (orange with diagonal hatching), PPO+Self-reflection (solid dark green), and PPO (light green with diagonal hatching). For Mathverse, the bars are approximately DAPO+Self-reflection 56.1, DAPO 53.1, SRPO 55.8, GRPO 53.4, PPO+Self-reflection 54.5, and PPO 53.3. For MMLU, the bars are approximately DAPO+Self-reflection 56.9, DAPO 55.9, SRPO 57.1, GRPO 55.8, PPO+Self-reflection 56.2, and PPO 54.6. For Physics, the bars are approximately DAPO+Self-reflection 61.0, DAPO 57.5, SRPO 60.6, GRPO 58.1, PPO+Self-reflection 59.1, and PPO 56.9. The bars within each group are not sorted by height and there are no additional annotations beyond the legend and axis labels.
raw_responses.German: DESCRIPTION: Das Diagramm ist ein gruppiertes Balkendiagramm zur Darstellung der Genauigkeit (Accuracy) in Prozent für sechs Reinforcement-Learning-Konfigurationen über drei Benchmarks hinweg. Auf der horizontalen Achse stehen die Kategorien Mathverse, MMLU und Physics (von links nach rechts). Die vertikale Achse ist mit „Accuracy (%)“ beschriftet und zeigt eine lineare Skala von etwa 50 bis 62 mit regelmäßigen Tick-Abständen von 2 Prozentpunkten. Zu jeder Benchmark-Kategorie sind sechs Balken nebeneinander angeordnet und über eine Legende oben zugeordnet: DAPO+Self-reflection als durchgehend blauer Balken, DAPO als blau schraffierter Balken, SRPO als durchgehend orangefarbener Balken, GRPO als orange schraffierter Balken, PPO+Self-reflection als durchgehend grüner Balken und PPO als grün schraffierter Balken. Für Mathverse liegen die Balkenhöhen ungefähr bei DAPO ~53, DAPO+Self-reflection ~56, GRPO ~53,5, SRPO ~55,8, PPO ~53,3 und PPO+Self-reflection ~54,5. Für MMLU liegen die Werte ungefähr bei DAPO ~55,9, DAPO+Self-reflection ~56,9, GRPO ~55,8, SRPO ~57,1, PPO ~54,6 und PPO+Self-reflection ~56,2. Für Physics liegen die Balken ungefähr bei DAPO ~57,5, DAPO+Self-reflection ~61,0, GRPO ~58,1, SRPO ~60,6, PPO ~56,9 und PPO+Self-reflection ~59,1. Eine explizite Sortierung der Balken nach Höhe ist nicht erkennbar; die Reihenfolge innerhalb jeder Gruppe folgt der Legende, und es gibt keine zusätzlichen Hervorhebungen außer Farbe und Schraffur.
